apps.notes_en: Important if videos spin endlessly on your TV: YouTube currently blocks unauthenticated player requests on many ISP IPs ("Sign in to confirm you're not a bot") while still showing home thumbnails. After installing 32.83 Beta: (1) Sign in with a Google account inside SmartTube, and (2) If still slow on older TVs, switch Settings → General → Network settings → Network stack to OkHttp + enable Prefer IPv4 DNS — or use KV-Tube TV v1.2.5-tv (code 88105), which plays with no Google login required.
